settings.heading: The fine print
settings.text:
• Runs Friday, Nov 27 at 12:00 AM ET through Tuesday, Dec 1 at 9:00 AM ET.
  • 10% off film development: base Develop & Scan and Develop Only, every format.
  • Not included in the 10%: Rush, add-ons (border scans, TIFFs, extra-large scans and the rest), film, prints and merch.
  • 15% off cameras, lenses and gear priced $299.99 and up in the sale collection. Every qualifying item gets it.
  • Both discounts come off automatically at checkout. No code needed, and they can't be combined with discount codes.
  • Your development order has to be placed online during the sale to get the sale price.
  • We're open Friday, Saturday and Cyber Monday at regular hours, and closed Sunday.
